events.advice: Call 1930 (National Cyber Crime Helpline) or report at cybercrime.gov.in, especially if money or details were shared. Real police, CBI, customs, TRAI or banks never arrest anyone on a video call and never ask for an OTP or a transfer to a 'safe account'.
